_meta.identity: Matching is CONTENT-HASH based: gold expected_chunks[].content_hash = sha256(normalized stored text) from chunk_identity.py. The stored chunk text INCLUDES the deterministic contextual-retrieval prefix (dataprep prepends ctx\n\ntext; ctx gen is temperature 0, so the hash is re-ingest-stable under the same pipeline). The span emits the ArangoDB _key; run_eval.py converts each _key to its content hash at eval time. chunk_key (the _key) is retained for traceability only.
_meta.model_pins_note: embedding_dim = bge-base-en-v1.5 output dim (768). translation_model_id is null because the release/el-salvador stack runs no translation service (absent from the resolved stack) — recorded explicitly so Story 3.1 knows it was checked, not omitted.

abstention.note: q18 is a semantic-path abstention probe (out-of-corpus topic). It is NOT scored by the anchor eval (empty expected_chunks would give vacuous recall + pollution). Run via dump-tuples + run_ragas_eval to verify the system abstains.
abstention.query: What are the visa and work-permit requirements for foreign agricultural technicians in El Salvador?

_meta.eval_identity_gotcha: The deployed v1.3 reranker_selection span emits the ArangoDB _key, NOT content_hash. Matching is content-based: run_eval.py maps each span _key to content_hash (sha256 of normalized STORED text, contextual-retrieval prefix included) and scores against the gold's expected content_hash values. content_hash is stable across re-ingests as long as the pipeline (chunking + contextual-retrieval model/prompt, both temperature 0) is unchanged. A pipeline change that alters chunk text changes the hashes: a signal to re-baseline.
